{{Top|leg}}
'''Tactile writing''' was a term used to describe non-verbal forms of communication that made use of patterns or groupings of objects to represent ideas. Tactile writing was used by the [[Aalagar]] and [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
